# Chachakka Sutta (MN 148 (PTS MN iii 280))
**ID:** MN 148 (PTS MN iii 280)
**Section:** Majjhimanikāya (mn)
**Collection:** Suttas-Early-1
**Title (Pali):** Chachakka Sutta
**Title (English, from literature):** Six By Six
**PTS:** MN iii 280
**SuttaCentral:** https://suttacentral.net/mn148
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0203m.mul4.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
In Sri Lankan tradition preserved in the *Papañcasūdanī*, the celebrated preacher Maliyadeva thera famously recited the sutta across numerous vihāras (including the Lohapāsāda), each time leading sixty monks to arahantship [Adikaram 1946].
